[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question, choose Multiple choice, and give the options the respondent may tick.

![The choose-any question question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/multiple-choice-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/multiple-choice-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Answer set.** The options. Each becomes its own column in the data, ticked or not.
- **Required.** Asks for at least 1 tick.

## Best practices for research

Prefer asking yes or no for each option when every option matters: a choose-any list makes an unticked box ambiguous.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
